title: I-031 recoverable timeout, FIFO job queue, and steer applied to the next step
clauseOfficialized: A mid-generate timeout is RECOVERABLE_TIMEOUT, is journaled as recoverable, leaves the budget uncancelled, executes zero tool side effects, and a fresh command id can still run. A queued job that times out can be followed by the next queued job. Steer on a queued job is applied to the next step and cannot rewrite a finished receipt. FIFO queue: cancelling a not-yet-run job leaves side effects at 0. A timeout before generate does not claim the command id, so the same id can be retried.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increment 2.14 officialized turn, approval, hooks, cancel, and no-progress, and left timeout recovery plus steer/queue/job unofficialized.
